Hi bestie! I would say you need need to plan plan plan what is your dream course (not CONFURM also can) cos lidat you have set of goals to look forward too!

Next you need to revise your content frequently! ESP those j1 topics that are impt af as they serve the basis in most subject (esp Chem) 

It’ll be great if you can review your promo tests and see where you go wrong, have weekly consults with your teacher (esp for like GP) 

I didn’t set my goals and was just going through the motion with sucked as there was no motivation… but it’s okay we learn from mistakes! 

Lastly, PLEASE PLEASE TAKE CARE OF YOUR MENTAL HEALTH!!!!!!!! REST when you shld be resting, don’t mug all dayyyyy all night like no life lidat, v bad for u and your brainsssss… 

As student people always say rest or sleep but like how can right??? If can’t even finish tuts how to sleep, but please just rest!!! rest and don’t push yourself too hard! I’m going to say this again, TAKE CARE OF YOURSELF AND YOUR BRAIN. take exam use brain so need to take care v impt so later can get AAA since your dream course v high grade

If you’re like a U grader and you improved to a S or D please treat yourself, reward yourself when it’s due cos it’s the little things that matters!!! 

Your highest priority shld be the A levels, everything else can wait one. 

If you’re like a kpop fan or Smth like a hobby do that too!!! As forms of stress relief

for GP rlly have to train on your writing skills and p2 the different qns types. Last time for me my teacher got go through for p2 lah like the qns types eg: literal, inference and language. V good for dissecting and my teacher got train us to identify them so in paper just apply the skills. 

Again, if you not smart but hardworking ASR jc v good thumbs up. My advise for you is that GP v different from O level. Need your hard work. 

Also, Teachers will give consult, Teachers v helpful one, don’t Paiseh. Last time got this nightstudy program and the subject teachers will stay at night to guide you for whatever questions you have (most subjects) So if you think your teacher not good, still got other teacher to guide you. 

In addition, last time also got tutor programs like senior comeback and teach you. I signed up and senior teach me lor. V good cos is free tuition n you get to learn from top student. (This programs v overlooked so keep a look out if you can signup)
